title: 1995.08.23-Windows95-Midnight-Madness-NorwalkCT (home video); Internet Archive title "Windows 95 Launch at a CompUSA Store in Norwalk, Connecticut"
creator: Dan Lynch (named creator on the Internet Archive item and owner of the YouTube channel @danlynch203 that published the original upload). Who operated the camera is not stated anywhere.

original_date.recording: 1995-08-24 about 00:11 local time, from the camcorder date/time stamp burned into the picture (clock set by the camera owner; not independently calibrated)

depicted_event_date: Night of 1995-08-23 into 1995-08-24: Windows 95 'Midnight Madness' retail launch. The IA and YouTube titles use 1995-08-23, the evening the event began; the selected frame's stamp reads AUG. 24 1995, and adjacent frames read AM 12:11:21–29.
depicted_location: Norwalk, Connecticut, according to the uploader's title and description only. Nothing in the frame names the town. An undated online directory listing places a CompUSA at 360 Connecticut Ave, Norwalk, which is consistent with this but does not tie it to this footage.
identity_evidence: In-frame illuminated fascia sign reading 'COMP USA' / 'THE COMPUTER SUPERSTORE' (legible at native 854x480).

Same continuous clip continues through the store entrance into a CompUSA interior with Windows 95 retail displays ('It's Here!', stacked Windows 95 boxes, 'COMPUSA' aisle signage), consistent with the 24 August 1995 Windows 95 retail launch.
Downloaded file matches Internet Archive's published size and hashes (32302815 bytes; sha1 f79a200eeee5964ef6bcbfb714f5d209595168a4; md5 5af84982f1399c06989acd79403395fb).

original_file.acquired: Internet Archive MP4 (not committed to the repository; 32.3 MB). Identified by hash so it can be re-fetched and verified.
original_file.container: MP4; H.264 854x480 SAR 1:1, 30000/1001 fps, progressive; Opus audio; duration 230.621 s
original_file.committed_capture: source/original.png is that single decoded frame, uncropped and unscaled (854x480 RGB PNG).

picture_area_note: The upload is 16:9 with the 4:3 camcorder picture pillarboxed; the measured picture bounding box is x=111..743. The frame is a digitization of analog home video, not a still photograph.
version_model_evidence: Not applicable (storefront). The sign reads 'THE COMPUTER SUPERSTORE', CompUSA's own tagline.
transformations: Decoded one frame (n=1066) losslessly to PNG → source/original.png (no crop, scale, or color change).

Cropped to the 640x480 4:3 picture area at x=107 (only black pillarbox removed), uniform 2.25x Lanczos scale to 1440x1080, centered on a 1920x1080 black canvas → exports/editorial-frame.png. Details and inverse: evidence/framing.json.
1280x720 Lanczos downscale of the export → proofs/editorial-frame-720.png (review proof only).
license_name: Unresolved. The Internet Archive item carries a CC0 1.0 marking applied by a third-party uploader account, which is not the named creator; the creator's original YouTube upload shows the standard YouTube license (no Creative Commons marking).
license_marking_seen: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ (IA licenseurl field; see rights.json for why it is not relied upon)
credit_text: Proposed, pending rights review: "Home video: Dan Lynch — Windows 95 'Midnight Madness', CompUSA, Aug. 24, 1995. Via Internet Archive."
notes: Period-appropriate exterior storefront with recognizable signage; the date comes from the picture itself, not from a caption.
Night exposure and analog noise are inherent to the source; nothing has been sharpened, denoised, color-graded, or retouched.
Release blocked under R14 until rights are resolved.
